content.title: IDENTITY, AUTHENTICATION & ACCESS CONTROL
content.content:
- **RBAC with AD group mapping**: Granular Read / Write / Execute / Owner permissions applied at Org, Project Space, Project, and individual pipeline/account/file asset level. Users are provisioned into SnapLogic Orgs and Projects via Active Directory (AD) group membership, with no duplicate user provisioning required.

- **SSO via SAML 2.0**: SnapLogic Manager integrates with Airbus Helicopters' IdP (Azure AD, Okta, PingIdentity, or OpenAM). SnapLogic acts as a SAML Service Provider — users authenticate against AH's existing IdP; token claims map to account type (platform users, admin users, Citizen Developer accounts).

- **MFA enforcement**: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is configurable per user or organisation-wide. When SSO is enabled, MFA enforcement is delegated to AH's IdP — existing corporate MFA policies apply automatically.

- **API token authentication**: Programmatic access via API tokens for OAuth 2.0 client credentials, or certificate-based mutual TLS. All credentials stored encrypted in the Ground Plex credential vault — never transmitted to the SnapLogic cloud.

- **Application resource access control**: Fine-grained ACL model controls access to pipeline assets, credentials/accounts, and file resources post-authentication. Users see only resources within authorized Orgs/Projects/Spaces.
